name: Munetsugu Takeno
description: A defender who dies shielding Konda from debris and rises as a misshapen ghost.

description_citations.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu's forces kill Keiga; at Eiganjo O-Kagachi bites Yosei in half and Takeno dies protecting Konda; Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken, making O-Kagachi disappear.
timeline.quote: Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken and teleports out, making O-Kagachi disappear.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isamaru and the wounded Yosei rally the soldiers while an army of twisted ghosts led by a misshapen Takeno rises to aid Konda.
timeline.quote: the appearance of Isamaru and the hurt-but-still-fighting Yosei rallies them.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
